entities.summary: PL Kyodan, or the Church of Perfect Liberty , is a Japanese shinshūkyō founded in 1924 by Tokuharu Miki, who was a priest in the Ōbaku sect of Zen Buddhism. The stated aim of the Church of Perfect Liberty is to bring about world peace. It is headquartered in Tondabayashi, Osaka Prefecture, Japan.
